start.speaker: Colonial Runner
start.text: Stand aside, old woman! I carry dispatches under authority of the British Crown and Commissioner Champion at Kwa Junda.

choices.text: Whose land do your boots stand upon, messenger?
Take a message back to your master. The Giriama will not work his fields.

node_reproach.speaker: Colonial Runner
node_reproach.text: You do not understand power! The King has gunboats in Mombasa and armed askaris marching through Rabai. You cannot stop the railway or the taxes!

node_defiance.speaker: Colonial Runner
node_defiance.text: Hah! Commissioner Champion anticipated this stubbornness. If your youth do not report by month's end, the King's African Rifles will take them by force!

node_reply.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_reply.text: A bird does not surrender its nest because a leopard growls below the branch. Go, tell Champion that Mekatilili wa Menza is calling the council of the Kayas!

node_end.speaker: Colonial Runner
node_end.text: You are courting destruction, woman... I will tell him every word!

events.value: Confronted Champion's runner at the boundary path. Word will reach Kwa Junda that the Giriama refuse forced labor.
